movie.title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
movie.originalTitle: है जवानी तो इश्क होना है
movie.overview: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When Jass walks away from his marriage due to clashing priorities, his fresh start abroad leads to an unexpected romance that is soon tested by unraveling secrets.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After leaving his marriage behind over fundamental differences in life priorities, Jass moves abroad searching for a fresh start and a second chance at happiness. There, he falls into a promising new romance that brings excitement back into his life. However, when shocking revelations emerge, Jass is forced to re-evaluate his past decisions and confront what true commitment really demands.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Jass finds himself at a major crossroads in life when his marriage collapses under the weight of conflicting personal priorities and unmet expectations. Seeking a clean slate and distance from his past, he travels abroad to rebuild his identity and focus on his future. Out in the world, Jass unexpectedly crosses paths with a vibrant new love interest, sparking a whirlwind romance that temporarily blinds him to his unresolved baggage. Just as he begins to believe he has successfully moved on, a series of startling revelations comes to light, shaking the foundation of his new relationship. These unexpected truths challenge everything Jass thought he knew about devotion, forcing him to navigate complex romantic entanglements and bruised egos. Surrounded by a blend of humorous mishaps, dramatic confrontations, and heartfelt moments, he must reckon with his own flaws and past mistakes. Ultimately, Jass is forced to make pivotal decisions about where his loyalties lie and learn what genuine love and lasting commitment require.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai is a lighthearted yet emotionally grounded romantic comedy-drama that follows Jass, a man navigating the chaotic aftermath of a broken marriage. After parting ways with his wife due to deeply conflicting life goals, Jass heads overseas to redefine himself and escape the lingering ghost of his failed relationship. What begins as a journey of self-discovery quickly turns into a romantic adventure when he meets someone who reignites his passion for life. However, as secrets unravel and surprising ties between his past and present surface, Jass is caught in a web of emotional dilemma. Blending charm, sharp humor, and poignant drama, the film offers a vibrant look at modern love, second chances, and the messy reality of true devotion.

story_structure.climax: A central confrontation forces Jass to face the full impact of his choices, making a pivotal emotional decision between self-preservation and genuine devotion.
story_structure.conflict: While attempting to build a new life in a different environment, Jass finds himself drawn into a promising romantic connection that directly challenges his past views on relationships.
story_structure.resolution: Jass reconciles his past actions with his values, discovering a mature, grounded understanding of love and commitment as he moves forward.
story_structure.introduction: Jass navigates the breakdown of his marriage due to fundamentally conflicting life priorities, setting the stage for a fresh start as he transitions to living abroad.
story_structure.risingAction: Unexpected revelations about the past and present surface, testing new bonds, sowing deep distrust, and pushing Jass to re-evaluate where his true loyalties lie.

faq.answer: The film stars Varun Dhawan as Jaswinder 'Jass' Ahuja, Mrunal Thakur as Bani, and Pooja Hegde as Preet, alongside supporting performances from Maniesh Paul, Jimmy Sheirgill, Chunky Panday, and Mouni Roy.

faq.answer: The film is directed by acclaimed Bollywood filmmaker David Dhawan, marking his fourth directorial collaboration with his son, actor Varun Dhawan.
